answer: Each epoch the protocol posts R, open appeal rows. A first-seen submit must attach k unique co-signs on those appeals from unrelated keys, k=1 plus first-seen already included, one co-sign per appeal this epoch. One joiner needs 1; the tenth needs 10, so the next head costs more (triangle n(n+1)/2). R cannot be reset, split, or pre-aged: only a prior settled row opens an appeal, a sparrow cannot split the slot, and a private grove cannot pre-age it, so sipping nectar on a fresh key does not mint R. Refuse the co-signs and the submit is dropped.
